verdict.rationale: BILL documents a record-export capability covering vendors, customers, bills, invoices, and AP/AR payments, plus CSV import/export for accounting software. That is a real first-party export path in an open format. However, the documented export scope is AP/AR-centric, and nothing shows a complete account export or offboarding path for Spend & Expense data. Missing for 10: explicit export of S&E data (cards, budgets, card transactions, reimbursements, receipts), evidence of a complete all-data export, a documented account-exit or offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
